parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set ethernet-switching-options cfm versi.explanation: 配置以太网交换选项中的CFM版本为标准。

parameters.name: version
parameters.explanation: CFM的版本，此处为标准版本。

set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.command: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain md3 level 3

set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.template: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] vlan-id [parameter3]
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.command: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain md3 maintenance-association ma3 vlan-id 2
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.explanation: 配置CFM维护域中维护关联的VLAN ID。

set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.template: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] mep [parameter3] interface [parameter4] direction [parameter5]
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.command: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain md3 maintenance-association ma3 mep 3 interface ge-1/0/1 direction down
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.explanation: 配置CFM维护域中维护关联的MEP接口及其方向。

set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.template: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] mep [parameter3] ccm [parameter4]
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.command: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain md3 maintenance-association ma3 mep 3 ccm enable
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.explanation: 启用CFM维护域中维护关联的MEP的CCM功能。

set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.template: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] mep [parameter3] remote-mep-id [parameter4]
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.command: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain md3 maintenance-association ma3 mep 4 remote-mep-id 4
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.explanation: 配置CFM维护域中维护关联的MEP的远程MEP ID。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching interface-mode [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode trunk
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family et.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换模式为trunk。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan members [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members vlan2
